description: DECISION GATE: start only when GitHub confirms merge-queue support for native stacks on BenchBox-dev/BenchBox (public preview since 2026-07-30; queue support rolling out; stacks cannot use auto-merge; same-repo only; gh extension install github/gh-stack). Pilot one dependent core change (2-3 layers): each layer gets ci.yml on pull_request (no branch filter), layers land bottom-up through the queue, children auto-rebase.
